functions.description: Compute the double-declining-balance depreciation rate per year from the useful life of an asset.
inputs: the useful life of the asset in years

functions.description: Compute one year of double-declining-balance depreciation from the beginning book value and rate, limited so the ending book value never falls below salvage value.
inputs: the salvage value of the asset (estimated residual value) with currency unit
outputs: ending book value for the year

functions.description: Iterate year-by-year double-declining-balance depreciation on the beginning book value up to the requested year, respecting the salvage floor.
inputs: the original cost of the asset (basis) with currency unit
the salvage value of the asset (estimated residual value) with currency unit
the year at which the book value is requested (the target year, as a year number)
outputs: iterative book value at the end of the requested year

functions.description: Verify the book value of a double-declining-balance depreciating asset at a requested year using the closed-form expression cost times one minus the rate raised to the year count, floored at salvage value.
inputs: the original cost of the asset (basis) with currency unit
the salvage value of the asset (estimated residual value) with currency unit
the year at which the book value is requested (the target year, as a year number)
outputs: closed-form book value at the requested year

functions.description: Determine the book value of an asset at the end of a requested year under double-declining-balance depreciation with salvage value.
inputs: the original cost of the asset (basis) with currency unit
the salvage value of the asset (estimated residual value) with currency unit
the useful life of the asset in years
the depreciation method to apply, which must be double-declining-balance depreciation
the year at which the book value is requested (the target year, as a year number)
outputs: book value at the end of the requested year

entry_points.text: Equipment costs ●1, has a salvage value of ●2, and a useful life of ●3. Using ●4, what is its book value at the end of ●5?

params.description: the original cost of the asset (basis) with currency unit
params.validity_range: Positive real currency amount; must be strictly greater than the salvage value (●2), otherwise there is no depreciable base and the book value is trivially the cost.

params.description: the salvage value of the asset (estimated residual value) with currency unit
params.validity_range: Non-negative currency amount, and strictly less than the original cost (●1); a salvage value of zero is allowed and simply removes the floor.

params.description: the useful life of the asset in years
params.validity_range: Positive integer number of years, at least 2 so that the DDB rate 2/n does not exceed 1 (n=1 would imply a rate of 200%, which is meaningless beyond the salvage floor).

params.description: the depreciation method to apply, which must be double-declining-balance depreciation
params.validity_range: Must denote the double-declining-balance method (rate equal to twice the straight-line rate 1/n applied to beginning book value); other methods such as straight-line or sum-of-years-digits require different calculations and are outside this template.

params.description: the year at which the book value is requested (the target year, as a year number)
params.validity_range: Non-negative integer year index, from 0 (cost itself, unchanged book value) up to the useful life (●3); beyond the useful life the asset is fully depreciated and the book value equals the salvage value.
